description: This file defines authentication dependencies for a FastAPI application, including custom API key header handling, user retrieval, and token validation.

classes.name: RWAPIKeyHeader
classes.description: Custom API key header class that extends FastAPI's APIKeyHeader to handle exceptions and provide custom error messages.

methods.name: get_current_user_authorizer
methods.description: Returns a dependency callable that retrieves the current user, optionally requiring authentication.

methods.name: _get_authorization_header_retriever
methods.description: Returns a callable to retrieve the authorization header, with optional requirement.

methods.name: _get_authorization_header
methods.description: Extracts and validates the token from the authorization header, checking token prefix.

methods.name: _get_authorization_header_optional
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization token if present, or returns an empty string.

methods.name: _get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the JWT token, raising exceptions if invalid or not found.

methods.name: _get_current_user_optional
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the current user if a token is provided.
